The story so far

From custom orders to a first location

CakeItKing built its name on custom cakes and treats made to order for events, taking bookings long before it had a shop to walk into.

That changed on Sunday 15 November 2026, when CakeItKing opened its first location with a grand opening inside GC Jerk Xpress at 2849 Weston Road in Toronto.

The kitchen is Food Handlers Certified, and the order book is open now for November and December.

First location, opened 15 Nov 2026 Food Handlers Certified Booking for Nov and Dec

Watch one come together

Every cake starts as your idea.Tell us the occasion, the colours and the person it is for. That is where every CakeItKing cake begins.

Then it rises, tier by tier.Stacked, smoothed and finished by hand, one layer at a time, until it stands the way you pictured it.

Crowned, and ready for the table.The last touch goes on top, and the cake is ready for its moment.

New at the counter

The Festival Bar

The newest thing at the Weston Road location is not a cake at all. Launched together with GC Jerk Xpress, the Festival Bar serves Jamaican festival dough with your choice of sweet toppings.

Order it at the counter when you come in, or add it to the conversation when you book your cake.
